# Hoberg Digital Agency

> Hoberg Digital Agency is a Lagos-based digital agency offering website design, mobile app development, content creation and ads management for SMEs across Nigeria. Known for its 2026 AI Visibility Report auditing 50 Nigerian businesses including Dangote, BUA Group, GTBank, Zenith Bank, Flutterwave, Paystack, Jumia and Interswitch.

## What is AI Visibility?
AI visibility is how well ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and other AI search engines can understand, trust and cite your business website. Hoberg Digital Agency Lagos created the first Nigerian AI Visibility Report in 2026 auditing 50 real businesses.

## How to check AI visibility?
Check: SEO title, meta description, mobile viewport, blog freshness, FAQ schema, organization info. Use Hoberg free AI visibility checker at https://hoberg.com.ng/tools/
